hub.sub: SaaS buyers compare, trial and loop in a team before they talk to sales. We plan search, funnels and CRM signals around qualified pipeline.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: B2B SaaS and software marketing is the work of reaching buyers who compare tools, try them and involve a team before buying. It joins comparison and problem search, demo and trial funnels, accurate lead scoring from your CRM and reporting on qualified pipeline rather than sign-ups or form fills.

answer.chip: Pipeline you can trace to a source

paras: A software buyer usually starts with a problem, reads comparisons and reviews, looks at pricing and tries a demo or trial. A team often joins the decision, and security and integration questions come up late.
Marketing that only collects sign-ups misses what sales and product see after.
blocks.cap: Illustrative scene: a short demo request form.

blocks.h: The problem that keeps coming back
paras: Many SaaS teams get leads that never activate or never answer, and optimise for cheap form fills. Platforms then learn to find more of the same.
Sending real qualification stages from your CRM back to the platforms, and judging by pipeline, changes what they optimise for. See lead generation and the guides.
